evidence:
Built a requirement-to-criterion map from instruction.md (lines 1-19), environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md (sections 1-9) and integration.md against the gate and scored judge.toml criteria and the functional/polish protocols. Workbook row 26 (Quality Checks) plus its Internal Quality Checks annotation ('we usually combine the multiple verifeirs in one flow ... we dont need to retest it') and skill quality-checks.md #26 (several rules in one criterion is a flow, not a gap) were applied together with REVIEW_POLICY 'Coverage has two directions'.

MAPPED: sign-in and usable staff workspace -> hro_gate_render; server-backed shared save -> hro_gate_shared; 401/403/404 (rules s1) -> hro_anonymous, hro_refusal_status (Observer/candidate/Ingrid 403, candidate 404, stale 409), hro_candidate_private (other application's conversation not found); job fields, places whole 1-50, HM must be an HM account, recruiter-only -> hro_job_open, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff; add candidate at bottom of Applied -> hro_add_candidate; email validity, case-insensitive duplicate per job, other job allowed, error at the field with typed values kept -> hro_add_email_rules; candidate-account email links application -> hro_candidate_linked; one stage forward/back, skip refused, ordinary controls, shown at once -> hro_move_one_stage; arrival at bottom -> hro_arrive_bottom; hand re-order shared/persisted -> hro_reorder and hro_restart; reject non-Hired with a non-blank reason, rejected-from kept -> hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired; reopen only to rejected-from stage, reason cleared, undo gives the reason back -> hro_reopen; Interview places -> hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full; HM rights -> hro_mgr_late_stages, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job; stale 409 changes nothing and names who -> hro_stale_refused; put back with reason and focus -> hro_refused_put_back; multi-card board order, mixed stages, all-or-none, places for the set -> hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none, hro_bulk_places; undo own last move, restore stage/place, blocked by move/re-order/reject by anyone, overfill, once only, superseded by a later move -> hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_full, hro_undo_once (a shared/global undo stack also fails protocol L and B(12), so 'own' undo is effectively graded); notes by role, Observer reads -> hro_notes; unsaved note kept on that browser -> hro_pol_session_resume and hro_pol_live_board; Activity kinds, who/what, reason, newest first, all/one job, never removed, refused leaves no line -> hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals; live within 15 s: moves and new cards -> hro_live_board, unread -> hro_unread_counts, messages -> hro_msg_exchange, seen marks -> hro_seen; updates leave typing/focus/open card/scroll -> hro_pol_live_board, open conversation/draft/focus -> hro_pol_live_thread; participants -> hro_thread_access; plain text, non-blank, line breaks, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty and focused after send -> hro_msg_compose; failed send kept with notice -> hro_pol_failed_send; latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest -> hro_thread_latest; earlier 30 at a time with remaining count -> hro_thread_earlier; place kept -> hro_pol_earlier_place; per-person unread, own never unread, sending counts as reading (Mei Lin's expected count in protocol U), per-conversation count and total, arrival at newest is read -> hro_unread_counts; scrolled-up arrival -> hro_unread_scrolled_up; seen incl. HM and Observer-never -> hro_seen; per-conversation drafts across views/reload -> hro_drafts; ended session re-prompts, draft restored, hidden from next user, sending clears -> hro_pol_session_resume, hro_msg_compose; candidate list title/team/wording and own conversations -> hro_candidate_view; candidate unread count on list -> hro_unread_counts (Lena starts with 1); candidate's own last message seen -> hro_seen (Tomas's page); candidate privacy -> hro_candidate_private; seed loaded once, kept across restart, no reseed -> hro_restart; views -> gates/functional; clear desktop workspace -> five visual Likert rows. Runtime launch rules (server.js-relative paths, uid 65534, env -i with PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH, writable copy) are enforced by tests/test.sh:85-113. Every 'graded only in X' redirect (hro_job_open, hro_arrive_bottom, hro_interview_full, hro_undo_restores, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_candidate_view, hro_drafts, hro_pol_failed_send, hro_pol_live_thread, hro_candidate_linked) points at a row that actually grades that leg; no orphaned redirect (Colderwater lessons 16/18 pattern checked).

RESIDUAL GAPS (reported because the row requires every gap; none judged blocking): (1) Candidate wording for Offer and Hired (rules s7 table) is named in hro_candidate_view, but no candidate-account application ever reaches Offer or Hired: seeded candidate applications are APP-101 INTERVIEW, APP-201 SCREEN, APP-301 REJECTED, APP-302 APPLIED, and protocol K (functional/prompt.md:51) moves Tomas's J2 card 'through two stages' and rejects/reopens it, so only 4 of 6 wordings are observed. (2) 'A conversation opens when the candidate chooses it; signing in doesn't open one for them' (hireops_rules.md:187-188) has no named criterion leg; it is covered only indirectly by hro_unread_counts' Lena leg (her sole application APP-301 would be marked read by an auto-open). (3) 'Adding a note doesn't count as a change' (rules s3 Undo) is exercised in protocol B(12), and an app that blocks undo on a note fails hro_undo_conflict ('the undo after an unrelated change is refused'), but the criterion text never names the note. (4) 'GET /api/health ... never touches the database', 'Express and SQLite', 'don't install packages', 'start with no shipped database' (instruction.md:15-17) are template/runtime policy a browser judge cannot observe; test.sh only probes /api/health or / for readiness. Per REVIEW_POLICY these are recorded, not turned into source-reading criteria. (5) The refusing page 'catches up' after a 409 (rules s3 Two people at once) is covered only generally by hro_live_board, because protocol C replays the stale move rather than driving a stale UI. This static mapping row needs no runtime evidence; the raw-evidence index states configured judge, Oracle and model runs are absent, and nothing here claims a measured score.
counterexample: Bounded, not blocking: an app showing candidates 'Offer extended' for OFFER or 'Joined' for HIRED (contrary to the rules s7 table) still passes hro_candidate_view, because no candidate-account application reaches Offer or Hired in any protocol (seed APP-101 INTERVIEW, APP-201 SCREEN, APP-301 REJECTED, APP-302 APPLIED; protocol K moves Tomas's J2 card two stages then reject/reopen). An app that auto-opens a candidate's conversation at sign-in is caught only indirectly through Lena's starting unread count.
suggested_fix: Optional and cheap: in protocol K advance Tomas's J2 card on to Offer and Hired (on a second linked card if the reject/reopen leg must stay) and read the candidate wording at each stage; optionally name 'signing in does not open a conversation' and 'a note does not block undo' as legs of hro_candidate_view/hro_unread_counts and hro_undo_conflict. Re-review rows 27, 28, 31 and the workload if changed.
